text:
You can use Monzo’s **Current Account Switch Service (CASS)**. It transfers your Direct Debits and standing orders, moves the remaining balance, redirects incoming payments such as salary, and closes your old account.

1. **Open a Monzo current account** in the app.
2. In the app, tap the **+** button and choose **“Switch to Monzo”**.
3. Follow the prompts. You’ll need details for the account you’re switching from; choose a switch date at least **7 working days** ahead. It can’t be a weekend or bank holiday.
4. Keep using your old account until the switch date. Avoid setting up new payments on it during the switching period, as they may not be transferred.
5. Once the switch is complete, check your Direct Debits in Monzo and contact Monzo in the app if any are missing.

Before starting, make sure your address details match at both banks. Also check whether you have linked accounts or products—such as a joint account or certain savings or investment Pots—that Monzo says may need to be closed before switching. If you want to keep your old account open, check the options in the app: a full CASS switch closes it. 

Sources: [Monzo’s switching guide](https://monzo.com/switch) · [Current Account Switch Service: personal switching process](https://www.currentaccountswitch.co.uk/the-switching-process-personal/)
